title: Combinatorial aspects of the non-symmetric strong spectral property for graphs
summary: In this paper, we investigate the non-symmetric Strong Spectral Property (nSSP) from a combinatorial perspective. To zero-nonzero patterns of matrices we associate directed graphs and study when they require or allow the nSSP, providing a framework that avoids verifying the nSSP for individual matrices. A new combinatorial method is introduced and used to recognise several patterns that require the nSSP.
